name: r2-d6
description: r2-d6 v2: companheiro de mesa para o Star Wars RPG REUP (D6)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @r2d6/api" "npm run dev -w @r2d6/web"
scripts.build: npm run data:build && npm run build -w @r2d6/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/rules && tsc --noEmit -p packages/data && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
